lines.text: 따뜻한 여름날, 엄마 오리가 둥지에서 알을 품고 있었어요.
lines.en: On a warm summer day, Mama Duck sat on her nest, keeping her eggs warm.

lines.text: 알을 톡 눌러서 아기 오리를 깨워 줄까요?
lines.en: Shall we tap an egg to wake up the ducklings?
segs: Shall we tap an egg to wake up the ducklings?

lines.text: 알을 톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Tap the egg!

lines.text: 노란 아기 오리 넷이 나왔어요. 삐약삐약!
lines.en: Four little yellow ducklings hatched. Peep peep!
segs: Four little yellow ducklings hatched. Peep peep!

lines.text: 어? 제일 큰 알은 아직이에요. 톡톡톡 두드려 볼까요?
lines.en: Oh? The biggest egg is still waiting. Shall we tap, tap, tap it?
segs: Oh? The biggest egg is still waiting. Shall we tap, tap, tap it?

lines.text: 큰 알을 톡톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Tap, tap the big egg!

lines.text: 크고 회색인 아기 오리가 나왔어요! 머리에 알껍데기 모자를 썼네요.
lines.en: A big gray duckling hatched! Look, an eggshell hat on its head.
segs: A big gray duckling hatched! Look, an eggshell hat on its head.

lines.text: 톡! 모자가 떨어졌어요.
lines.en: Pop! The hat fell off.

lines.text: 엄마 오리가 말했어요. "어머, 이 아기는 크고 회색이구나. 그래도 괜찮아. 모두 내 아기란다!"
lines.en: Mama Duck said. "Oh my, this baby is big and gray. That's okay. You are all my babies!"
segs: Oh my, this baby is big and gray. That's okay. You are all my babies!

lines.text: 엄마 오리가 아기들을 데리고 연못에 갔어요. 줄을 서서 헤엄쳐요.
lines.en: Mama Duck took her babies to the pond. They swam in a line.

lines.text: 화면을 옆으로 쓱 밀어서 헤엄쳐 볼까요?
lines.en: Shall we swipe the screen sideways to swim?
segs: Shall we swipe the screen sideways to swim?

lines.text: 옆으로 쓱 밀어서 헤엄쳐요!
lines.en: Swipe sideways to swim!

lines.text: 회색 아기 오리는 헤엄을 제일 잘해요! 쏙 들어갔다가 퐁!
lines.en: The gray duckling swims the best! Dive in, and pop up!
segs: The gray duckling swims the best! Dive in, and pop up!

lines.text: 그런데 늘 줄 맨 끝에서 혼자 따라가요.
lines.en: But the gray duckling always follows at the very end of the line, all alone.
segs: But the gray duckling always follows at the very end of the line, all alone.

lines.text: 농장 마당에 닭이랑 오리들이 모여 있어요.
lines.en: Chickens and ducks are gathered in the farmyard.

lines.text: 수탉이 말했어요. "꼬꼬댁! 너는 못생겼어!"
lines.en: The rooster said. "Cock-a-doodle-doo! You're ugly!"

lines.text: 오리들도 말했어요. "꽥꽥! 너는 우리랑 달라!"
lines.en: The ducks said. "Quack quack! You're not like us!"
segs: Quack quack! You're not like us!

lines.text: 아기 오리 마음은 어떨까요?
lines.en: How does the duckling feel?

lines.text: 아기 오리 마음은 지금 어떨까요?
lines.en: How does the duckling feel now?
segs: How does the duckling feel now?

lines.text: 혼자 남은 아기 오리 마음은 어떨까요?
lines.en: How does the lonely duckling feel?
segs: How does the lonely duckling feel?

lines.text: 지금 백조 마음은 어떨까요?
lines.en: How does the swan feel now?
segs: How does the swan feel now?

lines.text: 아기 오리 얼굴을 잘 봐요. 눈썹이랑 입이 어떻게 생겼지?
lines.en: Look closely at the duckling's face. What do the eyebrows and mouth look like?

lines.text: 기쁜 얼굴이에요! 반짝이는 얼굴을 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: It's a happy face! Tap the sparkling face.
segs: It's a happy face! Tap the sparkling face.

lines.text: 슬픈 얼굴이에요! 반짝이는 얼굴을 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: It's a sad face! Tap the sparkling face.
segs: It's a sad face! Tap the sparkling face.

lines.text: 무서워하는 얼굴이에요! 반짝이는 얼굴을 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: It's a scared face! Tap the sparkling face.
segs: It's a scared face! Tap the sparkling face.

lines.text: 화난 얼굴이에요! 반짝이는 얼굴을 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: It's an angry face! Tap the sparkling face.
segs: It's an angry face! Tap the sparkling face.

lines.text: 맞아요. 아기 오리는 슬퍼요. 눈물이 똑 떨어졌어요.
lines.en: That's right. The duckling is sad. A tear dropped.
segs: That's right. The duckling is sad. A tear dropped.

lines.text: 아기 오리를 톡 눌러서 쓰다듬어 줄까요? "괜찮아."
lines.en: Shall we tap the duckling to give it a gentle pat? "It's okay."
segs: Shall we tap the duckling to give it a gentle pat? "It's okay."

lines.text: 아기 오리를 톡! 쓰다듬어 줘요.
lines.en: Tap! Give the duckling a gentle pat.
segs: Tap! Give the duckling a gentle pat.

lines.text: "괜찮아. 너는 너라서 멋져."
lines.en: "It's okay. You are wonderful just as you are."
segs: "It's okay. You are wonderful just as you are."

lines.text: 엄마 오리도 말했어요. "우리 아기는 헤엄을 제일 잘한단다!"
lines.en: Mama Duck said too. "My baby swims the best!"

lines.text: 수탉과 오리들이 머쓱해서 말했어요. "놀려서 미안해."
lines.en: The rooster and the ducks felt shy and said. "Sorry for teasing you."
segs: The rooster and the ducks felt shy and said.

lines.text: 그래도 아기 오리는 마음이 쓸쓸했어요. 넓은 세상을 보러 길을 떠났어요.
lines.en: Still, the duckling felt lonely. So it set off to see the wide world.
segs: Still, the duckling felt lonely. So it set off to see the wide world.

lines.text: 갈대가 아기 오리 머리보다 훨씬 높아요.
lines.en: The reeds are much taller than the duckling's head.

lines.text: 옆으로 쓱 밀어서 갈대를 헤치고 가 볼까요?
lines.en: Shall we swipe sideways and push through the reeds?
segs: Shall we swipe sideways and push through the reeds?

lines.text: 옆으로 쓱! 갈대를 헤치고 가요.
lines.en: Swipe! Push through the reeds.

lines.text: 뒤뚱뒤뚱, 갈대숲을 지나 넓은 늪에 닿았어요.
lines.en: Waddle, waddle, past the reeds, and on to a wide marsh.

lines.text: 늪에는 기러기들이 살고 있었어요.
lines.en: Geese lived in the marsh.

lines.text: 기러기들이 말했어요. "안녕! 우리랑 같이 놀자!"
lines.en: The geese said. "Hello! Let's play together!"

lines.text: 맞아요! 친구가 생겨서 기뻐요.
lines.en: That's right! The duckling is happy to have made friends.
segs: That's right! The duckling is happy to have made friends.

lines.text: 기러기들과 아기 오리는 신나게 놀았어요.
lines.en: The geese and the duckling played and played.
segs: The geese and the duckling played and played.

lines.text: 저 멀리서 큰 소리가 났어요. 깜짝 놀란 기러기들이 모두 날아가 버렸어요.
lines.en: A loud noise came from far away. The startled geese all flew off.
segs: A loud noise came from far away. The startled geese all flew off.

lines.text: 맞아요. 아기 오리는 무서워요. 갈대 속에 웅크렸어요.
lines.en: That's right. The duckling is scared. It curled up in the reeds.
segs: That's right. The duckling is scared. It curled up in the reeds.

lines.text: 갈대를 톡 눌러서 아기 오리를 살포시 덮어 줄까요?
lines.en: Shall we tap the reeds to cover the duckling softly?
segs: Shall we tap the reeds to cover the duckling softly?

lines.text: 갈대를 톡! 살포시 덮어 줘요.
lines.en: Tap the reeds! Cover it softly.
segs: Tap the reeds! Cover it softly.

lines.text: 쉿, 이제 조용해요. 아기 오리는 갈대 속에서 포근하게 쉬었어요.
lines.en: Shh, it's quiet now. The duckling rested cozily in the reeds.
segs: Shh, it's quiet now. The duckling rested cozily in the reeds.

lines.text: 어느덧 가을이 되었어요. 아기 오리는 조금 더 자라 어린 새가 되었어요.
lines.en: Before long, it was autumn. The duckling had grown a little and become a young bird.

lines.text: 하늘 높이 하얀 새들이 줄지어 날아가요. 톡 눌러 볼까요?
lines.en: White birds are flying high in the sky, in a line. Shall we tap them?
segs: White birds are flying high in the sky, in a line. Shall we tap them?

lines.text: 하늘의 하얀 새들을 톡!
lines.en: Tap the white birds in the sky!
segs: Tap the white birds in the sky!

lines.text: 뿌우~ 나팔 같은 소리! 백조들이에요.
lines.en: Whoo~ A sound like a trumpet! They are swans.
segs: Whoo~ A sound like a trumpet! They are swans.

lines.text: 아기 오리는 오래오래 하늘을 올려다보았어요. "나도 저렇게 날고 싶다."
lines.en: The duckling gazed up at the sky for a long, long time. "I want to fly like that, too."
segs: The duckling gazed up at the sky for a long, long time.
I want to fly like that, too.

lines.text: 추운 겨울이 왔어요. 호수가 꽁꽁 얼어서 발이 얼음에 붙어 버렸어요.
lines.en: Cold winter came. The lake froze solid, and the duckling's feet got stuck in the ice.
segs: Cold winter came. The lake froze solid, and the duckling's feet got stuck in the ice.

lines.text: 아기 오리를 꾹 눌러 봐요. 날개로 몸을 감싸서 따뜻하게!
lines.en: Press and hold the duckling. Wrap your wings around you to keep warm!
segs: Press and hold the duckling. Wrap your wings around you to keep warm!

lines.text: 아기 오리를 꾹 누르고 있어요.
lines.en: Keep holding the duckling.

lines.text: 날개로 몸을 꼭 감쌌더니 조금 따뜻해졌어요.
lines.en: Wrapped tight in its wings, the duckling got a little warmer.

lines.text: 그때 농부 할아버지가 지나가다 아기 오리를 보았어요. "저런, 얼음에 발이 붙었구나!"
lines.en: Then an old farmer passed by and saw the duckling. "Oh dear, your feet are stuck in the ice!"
segs: Then an old farmer passed by and saw the duckling.
Oh dear, your feet are stuck in the ice!

lines.text: 얼음을 톡톡톡 눌러서 깨 줘요!
lines.en: Tap, tap, tap the ice to break it!
segs: Tap, tap, tap the ice to break it!

lines.text: 얼음을 톡톡 눌러요!
lines.en: Tap, tap the ice!

lines.text: 쩍! 얼음이 깨졌어요. 발이 쏙 빠졌어요!
lines.en: Crack! The ice broke. The feet popped out!
segs: Crack! The ice broke. The feet popped out!

lines.text: 농부 할아버지가 아기 오리를 품에 폭 안았어요. 따뜻한 집으로 가요!
lines.en: The old farmer hugged the duckling close in both arms. Off to a warm house!
segs: The old farmer hugged the duckling close in both arms. Off to a warm house!

lines.text: 할머니 집은 난로가 있어 따뜻했어요. 고양이와 암탉도 함께 살았어요.
lines.en: Grandma's house was warm, with a stove. A cat and a hen lived there too.
segs: Grandma's house was warm, with a stove. A cat and a hen lived there too.

lines.text: 고양이가 말했어요. "야옹. 너, 가르릉 할 줄 아니?"
lines.en: The cat said. "Meow. Can you purr?"

lines.text: 아기 오리가 흉내를 내 보았어요.
lines.en: The duckling tried to copy it.

lines.text: 가르릉이 아니라 꽥! 모두 깔깔 웃었어요. 아기 오리도 웃었어요.
lines.en: Not a purr, but a quack! Everyone burst out laughing. The duckling laughed too.
segs: Not a purr, but a quack! Everyone burst out laughing. The duckling laughed too.

lines.text: 암탉이 말했어요. "꼬꼬. 그럼 알은 낳을 줄 아니?" 아기 오리는 고개를 저었어요.
lines.en: The hen said. "Cluck cluck. Then can you lay an egg?" The duckling shook its head.
segs: Cluck cluck. Then can you lay an egg?

lines.text: 아기 오리가 잘하는 건 뭘까요?
lines.en: What is the duckling good at?
segs: What is the duckling good at?

lines.text: 고양이: "가르릉은 내가 잘하지~"
lines.en: Cat: "I'm good at purring~"
lines.prev: What is the duckling good at?

lines.text: 암탉: "알 낳기는 내가 잘하지~"
lines.en: Hen: "I'm good at laying eggs~"

lines.text: 연못에서 쏙 들어갔다가 퐁! 기억나요?
lines.en: Remember? Dive into the pond, and pop up!
segs: Remember? Dive into the pond, and pop up!

lines.text: 헤엄이에요! 반짝이는 카드를 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: It's swimming! Tap the sparkling card.
segs: It's swimming! Tap the sparkling card.

lines.text: 맞아요! 아기 오리는 헤엄을 제일 잘해요.
lines.en: That's right! The duckling swims the best.
segs: That's right! The duckling swims the best.

lines.text: 고양이와 암탉이 고개를 끄덕였어요. "그렇구나! 모두 잘하는 게 다르구나."
lines.en: The cat and the hen nodded. "I see! Everyone is good at different things."
segs: The cat and the hen nodded.
I see! Everyone is good at different things.

lines.text: 따뜻한 봄이 왔어요. 아기 오리는 몸이 부쩍 자랐어요.
lines.en: Warm spring came. The duckling grew bigger and bigger.
segs: Warm spring came. The duckling grew bigger and bigger.

lines.text: 아기 오리를 꾹 눌러서 날개를 활짝 펴 볼까요?
lines.en: Shall we press and hold the duckling to spread its wings wide?
segs: Shall we press and hold the duckling to spread its wings wide?

lines.text: 꾹 누르고 있어요. 날개를 활짝!
lines.en: Keep holding. Wings wide open!

lines.text: 와, 날개가 이렇게 커졌어요!
lines.en: Wow, the wings have grown so big!
segs: Wow, the wings have grown so big!

lines.text: 한 번 더 꾹! 훨훨 날아 볼까요?
lines.en: Hold once more! Shall we fly, flap flap?
segs: Hold once more! Shall we fly, flap flap?

lines.text: 한 번 더 꾹! 훨훨!
lines.en: Hold once more! Flap flap!

lines.text: 훨훨! 아기 오리가 하늘을 날아요!
lines.en: Flap flap! The duckling is flying in the sky!
segs: Flap flap! The duckling is flying in the sky!

lines.text: 아기 오리가 호숫가에 내려앉았어요. 물에 누가 비쳤을까요?
lines.en: The duckling landed by the lake. Who is in the water?
segs: The duckling landed by the lake. Who is in the water?

lines.text: 길고 하얀 목, 커다란 하얀 날개…
lines.en: A long white neck, big white wings…
segs: A long white neck, big white wings…

lines.text: "어? 이게 나야?" 아기 오리는 하얀 백조였어요!
lines.en: "Huh? Is that me?" The duckling was a white swan!
segs: The duckling was a white swan!
lines.prev: It looks into the water and is surprised.

lines.text: 어떻게 자랐는지 순서대로 톡! 맨 처음은 뭐였지?
lines.en: Tap them in the order the duckling grew! What came first?
segs: Tap them in the order the duckling grew! What came first?

lines.text: 알 다음은 뭐였지?
lines.en: What came after the egg?

lines.text: 아기 다음은 뭐였지?
lines.en: What came after the baby?

lines.text: 어린 새 다음은 뭐였지?
lines.en: What came after the young bird?
segs: What came after the young bird?

lines.text: "나는 다음이야~"
lines.en: "I'm next~"
lines.prev: It tapped a card out of order. The card hops and speaks.

lines.text: 알이에요! 반짝이는 카드를 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: It's the egg! Tap the sparkling card.
segs: It's the egg! Tap the sparkling card.

lines.text: 아기예요! 반짝이는 카드를 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: It's the baby! Tap the sparkling card.
segs: It's the baby! Tap the sparkling card.

lines.text: 어린 새예요! 반짝이는 카드를 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: It's the young bird! Tap the sparkling card.
segs: It's the young bird! Tap the sparkling card.

lines.text: 백조예요! 반짝이는 카드를 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: It's the swan! Tap the sparkling card.
segs: It's the swan! Tap the sparkling card.

lines.text: 여름이에요! 반짝이는 카드를 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: It's summer! Tap the sparkling card.
segs: It's summer! Tap the sparkling card.

lines.text: 가을이에요! 반짝이는 카드를 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: It's autumn! Tap the sparkling card.
segs: It's autumn! Tap the sparkling card.

lines.text: 겨울이에요! 반짝이는 카드를 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: It's winter! Tap the sparkling card.
segs: It's winter! Tap the sparkling card.

lines.text: 봄이에요! 반짝이는 카드를 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: It's spring! Tap the sparkling card.
segs: It's spring! Tap the sparkling card.

lines.text: 알, 아기, 어린 새, 그리고 백조! 이렇게 자랐어요.
lines.en: Egg, baby, young bird, and then swan! That's how it grew.
segs: Egg, baby, young bird, and then swan! That's how it grew.

lines.text: 이번에는 아기 오리가 지나온 계절이에요.
lines.en: Now for the seasons the duckling went through.
segs: Now for the seasons the duckling went through.

lines.text: 알에서 나온 건 해님이 쨍쨍한 계절이었어요. 어느 카드일까요?
lines.en: The duckling hatched in the sunny, sunny season. Which card is it?
segs: The duckling hatched in the sunny, sunny season. Which card is it?

lines.text: 그다음, 나뭇잎이 빨갛게 물든 계절은?
lines.en: Next, the season when leaves turn red?
segs: Next, the season when leaves turn red?

lines.text: 그다음, 꽁꽁 얼음이 언 계절은?
lines.en: Next, the season when the ice freezes solid?
segs: Next, the season when the ice freezes solid?

lines.text: 마지막으로 꽃이 핀 계절은?
lines.en: Last, the season when flowers bloom?
segs: Last, the season when flowers bloom?

lines.text: 여름, 가을, 겨울, 봄! 계절이 한 바퀴 돌았어요.
lines.en: Summer, autumn, winter, spring! The seasons went all the way around.
segs: Summer, autumn, winter, spring! The seasons went all the way around.

lines.text: 백조들이 헤엄쳐 왔어요. "안녕! 너도 우리 친구야. 같이 살자!"
lines.en: The swans swam over. "Hello! You're our friend too. Let's live together!"
segs: Hello! You're our friend too. Let's live together!

lines.text: 맞아요! 백조는 정말 정말 기뻐요.
lines.en: That's right! The swan is so, so happy.
segs: That's right! The swan is so, so happy.

lines.text: 저 멀리 엄마 오리와 형제들도 반갑게 날개를 흔들어요. "잘 자랐구나!"
lines.en: Far away, Mama Duck and the other ducklings wave their wings happily. "You've grown so much!"
segs: Far away, Mama Duck and the other ducklings wave their wings happily.

lines.text: 백조들을 톡톡 눌러서 함께 춤을 춰요!
lines.en: Tap the swans to dance together!
segs: Tap the swans to dance together!

lines.text: 다르게 생겼던 아기 오리는 이렇게 멋진 백조로 자랐답니다.
lines.en: The duckling who looked different grew into a wonderful swan, just like this.
segs: The duckling who looked different grew into a wonderful swan, just like this.

lines.text: 백조 얼굴을 잘 봐요. 눈썹이랑 입이 어떻게 생겼지?
lines.en: Look closely at the swan's face. What do the eyebrows and mouth look like?

cut_purr: The duckling copies the cat. It tries to make a purring sound.

ui.달라도 괜찮아요. 모두 저마다 멋지게 자라요!: It's okay to be different. Everyone grows up wonderful in their own way!
